# GoogleTest 1.15.2

The unmodified upstream release archive is bundled for offline native test builds.
Its hash also matches the archive previously downloaded by this project's CMake.

- Source: https://github.com/google/googletest/archive/refs/tags/v1.15.2.tar.gz
- Direct archive: https://codeload.github.com/google/googletest/tar.gz/refs/tags/v1.15.2
- SHA-256: `7b42b4d6ed48810c5362c265a17faebe90dc2373c885e5216439d37927f02926`
- License: BSD 3-Clause, reproduced in `LICENSE` and preserved in the archive.

CMake verifies the archive before extraction. Update its filename and hash in
`server/tests/CMakeLists.txt` and this document when replacing it.
